name: work-session
description: Kick off and wrap up working sessions with your start and end commands, and give each session a useful title

startCommand.title: Start command
startCommand.description: The slash command (without the slash) that kicks off a working session. The kickoff is offered only in projects that have it.

endCommand.title: End command
endCommand.description: The slash command (without the slash) that wraps up a working session, offered when the context or a rate limit runs high.

kickoff.title: Kickoff
kickoff.description: band: offer the start command above the prompt (press 1 to run it, or just type to do something else). auto: run it as the session starts. off: never.

wrapAtPercent.title: Offer the wrap at (context %)
wrapAtPercent.description: Offer the end command once the context window is this full, or once a rate limit passes 90%. 0 turns the offer off.
